name: Codex Stream Deck
summary: Local macOS bridge for an Elgato Stream Deck and the Codex desktop app: task status, selected shortcuts, and weekly usage display.
requirements: macOS Accessibility and Automation permission for the bridge process
suitableFor: Local Codex desktop task visibility on macOS
Opening local Codex tasks from a Stream Deck
Displaying the remaining ordinary Codex weekly allowance
A 15-key Elgato Stream Deck MK.2 workflow
unsuitableFor: Claude Code or other AI-provider integrations
capabilities: Show up to five local Codex tasks with observed state and recency
Show remaining ordinary weekly allowance or no-data state
Run as a direct local bridge or optional login service
limitations: Relies on experimental internal Codex desktop files and shortcuts that can change
Remote and cloud task states are not represented by local running-state discovery
Stream Deck + mappings have synthetic coverage only; other hardware is experimental
Physical acceptance is partial and reboot/fresh-Mac acceptance was not performed
Approve sends Enter and Reject sends Escape to the focused Codex control without validating a specific pending approval
